kind.description: `local` is a bare-repo path on disk with no credential; `remote` is a URL that requires authentication.

origin.description: What becomes `git remote add origin <this>`. **No credential embedded**, by design: this is the value that gets written into the workspace's `.git/config`, readable by anyone with access to the project's directory.

token.description: Only on `remote`. The workspace OWNER's token (RN-058), decrypted at call time. Whoever receives it injects it per invocation and discards it.

username.description: User of the HTTP Basic pair; the token is the password.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

404.description: Project with no provisioned repository, or the workspace owner has no registered credential for the repository provider.
